releases.notes:
## Changelog
### Added
- Full 8-step advancement system: Power On, Craftsmanship, Underlying Logic, Assembly, Installation Guide, Sensing, Recycle, Limiter Breaker
- Reworked advancement tree: Emergency Meal as base prerequisite, Polish Fuel & Install Charger branch from it; First Charge now requires multiple prerequisites
- Rewritten zh_cn advancement texts, aligned with EN translations

### Fixed
- Fixed PCL2 startup crash: incorrect mixin injection target signature causing `InvalidInjectionException`
- Fixed missing refmap in production JARs causing all mixin injections to fail; builds now include full remapping

### Changed
- Unified 3 powered core item EN names to "Powered Core Mechanism"
- Removed percentage from leakage ability description to match zh_cn
